newsitem.title: USA: MedCare to offer therapy at nursing homes.
newsitem.headline: MedCare to offer therapy at nursing homes.

text.p: MedCare Technologies Inc on Monday said it planned to offer its urinary incontinence treatment program at nursing homes.
The program is based on behavioral techniques and neuromuscular electromyography biofeedback and did not entail the use of drugs or surgery, MedCare said.
MedCare said it planned to expand its program to allow specially trained clinicians to serve nursing home patients exclusively.
The company said it planned to open eight more centers this year. It operates centers in Norman, Oklahoma; Overland Park, Kansas; Winter Park, Florida; and Denver,
MedCare shares were unchanged at 6-1/4 early Monday afternoon.
